verdict.rationale: TrueLayer's Data API documents access to identity, accounts, transactions and balance data through a single interface, and the docs describe a combined onboarding-plus-first-payment flow. Neither item states that one user consent/connection session covers all these data products without separate flows, so the core claim is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that a single consent/link grants multiple scopes (identity, balances, transactions, verification) at once, evidence that data and payment products share one session, independent or hands-on corroboration.
